title: Corrigendum to “Detection of BRAF mutations from solid tumors using Tumorplex™ technology” [MethodsX 2 (2015), 316–322]
author: Yo, Hay, et al.

steps.title: Design PCR primers for BRAF V600
steps.instruction: Order the forward primer BRAF‑UP (5′‑GAA GAC CTC ACA GTA AAA ATA GGT GAT TTT GGU C‑3′) and reverse primer BRAF‑LP (5′‑TCAATGACTTTCTAGTAACTCAGCAGCATCTC‑3′) to amplify a 180 bp region of human genomic DNA encompassing the BRAF V600 locus.

steps.title: Design allele‑specific sequencing primers
steps.instruction: Order two sequencing primers that differ at the 3′ nucleotide and molecular weight: mutant V600E‑SP (5′‑AAC TGA TGG GAC CCA CTC CAT CGA GAT TTCT‑3′) which ends with deoxythymidine, and wild‑type V600‑SP (5′‑weighted‑AAC TGA TGG GAC CCA CTC CAT CGA GAT TTC A‑3′) which ends with deoxyadenosine. The weight difference will separate truncated molecules generated from each primer.
